description: Mocap skeletons have straight limbs (D57), so it is not an error. Left: root (1,0,0), mid (4,0,0), end (8,0,0), bones 3 and 4, so the pole is mid + 7 * (0,-1,0) = (4,-7,0). The Right root is turned 180 degrees about X, so its -Y is +Y and the pole is (-4,7,0): the direction is the root's, not the world's. The settings default is a quarter of the 7 length along +X from the end (-X on the mirrored side): (9.75,0,0) and (-9.75,0,0).
